note: Which modules a new card starts with. 'modules' lists the built-in modules in sidebar order (Basics is always on and not listed). A card's starting set is picked by the most specific thing known: the platform's structural model (from platforms.json) first, then the community type, then 'default'. These are only suggestions: people can always add or remove modules.

modules.label: Infrastructure
modules.description: Platform, software, costs, other tools, and where servers, members and admins are.

modules.label: Membership
modules.description: How people join and become members.

modules.label: Rules
modules.description: Community rules, covenants, and which behaviors and content they cover.

modules.label: Processes
modules.description: Moderation, conflict management, institutional change, and communication channels.

modules.label: Federation
modules.description: How the community connects with other servers: allow and block lists, responses, bridging.

byStructuralModel.note: Applied when the platform is known. Mixed models like 'Federation / Relay' match each part; if parts disagree (e.g. 'Centralized / Federation'), adding wins.
